fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33046D0 compares it with 2 (then the Guid at +0x18 is replaced by the uuid of an entity) and with 0 (then a transform is taken from the character when none is present).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: copied from the placement record, 16 bytes; default 0

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: copied from the placement record; for Type 2 overwritten with the 16-byte uuid returned by bg3.exe+0x107E6F0 (ls::uuid of an entity).

fields.name: field_28
fields.evidence: default 1 (the pair at +0x28 is initialised with 0x0101).

fields.name: HasTransform
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33046D0: when 0 and Type is 0 it copies 40 bytes of a transform into +0x2C and sets the byte to 1; when 1 it combines the transform at +0x2C with the scene transform.

fields.name: Transform
fields.evidence: 40 bytes: quaternion at +0x2C (default w = 1.0 at +0x38), translation at +0x3C, scale at +0x48 (default 1,1,1) - the order of Script Extender's Transform; bg3.exe+0x33046D0 multiplies it with the scene transform.

fields.name: Actors
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33046D0 (~esv::TimelineSystem::TriggerBehaviorTimelinePlacement) creates the component on a new entity (bg3.exe+0x3313BF0) and, for every placement record of the timeline content whose actor resolves to a character, inserts the character's entity handle (8-byte key, bg3.exe+0x721030) and fills a value of stride 0x58 (grow bg3.exe+0x3316E20).

fields.name: InvolvedEntities
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33046D0 inserts 8-byte entity handles of other involved entities that pass bg3.exe+0xAB4D90 (bg3.exe+0x721030 on component + 0x40). Constructor zeroes 0x40..0x70 as a set.

fields.name: DialogInstanceId
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33046D0 stores the first 4 bytes of its request argument, the same value it uses as key of the system's placement maps and later passes to StopBehaviorTimelinePlacement.

open_questions: TimelinePlacementActor is a copy of the 0x58-byte placement record of ls::TimelineContent; only Type, the Guid at +0x18, the flag at +0x29 and the transform are interpreted by the code read; field_8 / field_18 / field_28 are unnamed.
What the entities of the set at +0x40 are.
